title: Introducing IEX Signal v7
raw_text:
Introducing IEX Signal v7
Category: Trading; Alert 2026-014
Overview Effective August 17, 2026, IEX Exchange plans to introduce an enhanced Crumbling Quote Indicator ("CQI"). This enhanced CQI (“Signal v7”) will replace the current CQI ("Signal v6"). Like Signal v6, Signal v7 makes quote instability determinations for all Discretionary Limit (“D-Limit”) orders and Corporate Discretionary Peg (“C-Peg”) orders. Signal v7 also makes quote instability determinations for Discretionary Peg (“D-Peg”) and Primary Peg (“P-Peg”), unless the User has instructed IEX to apply the Quote Imbalance Indicator (“QII” or “Ultra-Passive Signal”) instead. There will be no configuration changes required by Users to utilize the Signal v7 enhancement for D-Limit, D-Peg, P-Peg, or C-Peg orders. Deployment Schedule Date Symbols Monday, August 17 'A' - 'F' Friday, August 21 All symbols ’A’ - ’Z’ Details The CQI is designed to predict crumbling quotes on either side of the market for all symbols. Signal v7’s nine quote instability rules, inputs, reference prices, and other values continue to operate in the same manner as Signal v6. Signal v6 utilizes real time relative quoting activity from eleven exchanges (the “Signal Exchanges”) as reference data for the quote instability rules. Signal v7 includes IEX's own Protected Quotation, in addition to the Protected Quotations of the Signal Exchanges, in the reference price calculations used to determine the Signal Best Bid and Signal Best Offer.
